item.title: CS 8801 — Designing and Building User Interfaces
item.description:
Graduate Teaching Assistant, Georgia Tech (online), Fall 2024 – Spring 2025.

I served as the instructor of record for this online section, designing the syllabus and curriculum and teaching roughly 100 students through biweekly seminar sessions on designing and building user interfaces.

item.title: 🎉 Presented work-in-progress at Northeast CHI
item.description: I presented my work-in-progress paper, From Puffs to Patterns: Ubiquitous Technology in Mapping E-Cigarette Consumption, at the Northeast CHI Symposium, sharing early results on multimodal sensing for understanding e-cigarette use.
